text: City street at night. First a faint navy background rectangle over the whole canvas, 780 by 480, centred at 400,250, named Night.
road: light gray rectangle zone, 780 x 110, at 400,430, name Road
Please write MAIN ST on the road.
Tall indigo rectangle for the first building: 120 wide, 250 high, at 90,240. Name it Tower1.
four tiny yellow squares in a grid at 90,200 for its windows
Then group Tower1 with those four windows and call the group Block1.
Second building, a teal rectangle named Tower2, 110 by 190, centred on 240,270.
Label Tower2 "HOTEL".
Is Tower2 smaller than Tower1?
Lamp post: a gray rectangle 12 wide and 130 tall at 380,305, call it Pole.
stick a small yellow circle on top at 380,220 and name it Bulb
Bulb and Pole together, as a group named Lamp.
Moon in the top right corner, medium white circle called Moon.
a scatter of stars: five tiny white stars in a row at the top
hmm make the stars gold instead
Traffic light time. A black rectangle 36 by 96 at 470,250, named Signal.
Red circle, tiny, at 470,220, call it RedLight
then a tiny yellow circle, AmberLight, at 470,250
and the tiny green one, GreenLight, at 470,280
Group Signal, RedLight, AmberLight and GreenLight; name it TrafficLight.
Car: a red rectangle, 140 by 50, at 580,405. Name it CarBody.
Two tiny black circles for wheels: Wheel1 at 540,435 and Wheel2, also tiny and black, a circle at 620,435.
Put CarBody and both wheels in one group, Car.
Bring the car to the front.
slide Car 60 px to the left
Where is CarBody now?
Bus stop on the right: gray rectangle, 10 wide 100 tall, at 720,320, called StopPole.
Small red hexagon labeled STOP right at 720,255. Its name is StopSign.
make a group BusStop out of StopPole and StopSign
Now a little person: small pink circle for the head at 330,300, name Head.
body: blue rectangle 30 x 56 at 330,352, call it Torso
Head and Torso are one person, group them as Walker.
Draw a dotted arrow from Torso to StopPole, that's where he is walking.
Label the arrow "to the bus".
How many circles are on the canvas?
which shapes are gold?
the moon looks too big, shrink it
Is Moon right of Signal?
Put a small gray oval near the moon, a cloud.
Delete the oval, it's a clear night.
copy Bulb
put the copy at 640,300
Give it a post too: gray rectangle 12 by 100 at 640,372, named Pole2.
Put the title "Night Shift" at the top, in white.
make the title huge
Undo that, huge looks silly over the stars.
Is there a path from Torso to StopPole?
Describe CarBody.
nice, I'm happy with the street
